chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Al-Nawfali, from Isa ibn Abdullah, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The one who extends a hand of favor to one of my family members, I shall suffice him on the Day of Resurrection.'
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for doing a favor to the Prophet's family according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith establishes a reciprocal divine guarantee where the Prophet (SAWW) personally intercedes for those who bestow favors upon the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing their unique status as recipients of charity (Zakat al-Sadaqah). This promise underscores the spiritual merit of nurturing kinship ties (Silat al-Rahim) with the Prophet's lineage, a core tenet in Shia jurisprudence and theology.
